verdict.rationale: Sardine's docs say users can be enrolled in ongoing monitoring, with alerts if a customer appears on a watchlist, and describe ongoing daily OFAC, PEP and adverse-media screening. That covers enabling ongoing screening per customer. Nothing documents disabling or unenrolling it, or how a compliance officer would toggle it. Missing for 10: a documented disable/unenroll action, the interface for toggling it (dashboard or API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can enable and disable ongoing screening for selected customers

citations.quote: you can also enroll users for ongoing monitoring, which means that we'll alert you if any of your customers end up on one of these lists.
Sardine enables you to perform both an initial screening and an ongoing daily OFAC Sanctions, PEP, and Adverse Media screening, ensuring screening on both existing and new customers.
